status: Hand-written expectations. The Python reference (two identical copies, Kai and AgentArmor) and AgentArmor's native port must reproduce every case exactly. values are [fact name, value] pairs in fact order; a measure's value is a string, or a list of strings when its limits use several comparison keys. facts_without_note fixes every fact field except the note. note_includes lists, by fact index, strings the note must contain: trusted inputs the note states, as given. Other note wording is the implementer's.
